name: run_shell
description: Run a shell command with the workspace as the working directory and return its exit code, stdout, and stderr. Use this for commands the dedicated checker tools do not cover (builds, ad-hoc inspection, project tooling); prefer the `typecheck` and `test` tools for typechecking and test runs. A non-zero exit code is a normal result to read and iterate on, not an error.

detailed: Runs a shell command in the workspace and returns its output.
whimsical: Whisper to the machine in its own tongue.

detailed: tool {participantRole} is running a shell command

command.description: The shell command to run, executed via `sh -c` with the workspace as the working directory, so pipes, redirects, and compound commands work.

timeoutSeconds.description: Optional timeout in seconds. Capped by the executor default tool timeout; a value above the cap is clamped to the cap.
